nested_cost_notes: STB total contains upgrade, VM checks, native builds, PGO instrumentation/training/merge/final build, measurements and readback.
PGO preparation already contains the final PGO build; do not add the final build again.
Each NDU outer command contains its learning, selection, final search, oracle audits, native paired qualification and any report readback.
The module input references the already-completed STB campaign; the module NDU command does not rerun or double-charge that campaign.
AI final preparation subphases overlap their enclosing recorded commands; per-cell delivery and validation intervals are separate.
CI job durations include setup and execution and may overlap each other; sum of jobs is not campaign elapsed wall time.
Prior-head development and failed attempts remain separate observations and are not credited as final-head successes.
overall_total_deliberately_absent: incomplete historical coverage and nested/concurrent scopes do not support one complete total
